hours.daily.source: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (India): normal daily working hours
hours.daily.note: Time worked beyond 8 hours in a day is counted as daily overtime.

ot.weekly.source: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (India): normal weekly hours
ot.weekly.note: Time worked beyond 48 normal hours in a week is counted as weekly overtime.

ot.multiplier.source: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 & Code on Wages, 2019 (India): overtime wages at twice the ordinary rate of wages
ot.multiplier.note: Mandatory 2x rate for all overtime hours.

rest.weeklyDays.source: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (India): weekly day of rest
rest.weeklyDays.note: At least one rest day every 7 days.

pay.deductionReasonRequired.source: Code on Wages, 2019 (India): authorised deductions from wages must specify reason and category
pay.deductionReasonRequired.note: Unexplained wage deductions are flagged for review.

rest.minGapHours.source: Workplace policy: minimum turnaround rest between consecutive shifts

fatigue.maxConsecutiveDays.source: Workplace policy: maximum consecutive days worked without rest day
fatigue.maxConsecutiveDays.note: Alert triggered when worker works more than 6 days in a row.

fatigue.maxRolling7dHours.source: Workplace policy: rolling 7-day cumulative hour ceiling
fatigue.maxRolling7dHours.note: Alert triggered when rolling 7-day hours exceed 60h.

hazard.floorHigh.source: Workplace safety policy: mandatory high-severity floor for life-safety construction hazards
hazard.floorHigh.note: Electrical, fall from height, scaffold, structural collapse, crane lifting, and fire cannot be graded below High.

hazard.hotspotThreshold.source: Workplace safety policy: near-miss zone hotspot threshold
hazard.hotspotThreshold.note: Zones with 3 or more reports within 14 days are flagged as active hotspots.
